results.name: the persisted-state oracle awaits false async results and rejects a failed negative control
content anchor survives real edge scrolling and retains offscreen crossed rows
subpixel edge velocity progresses at the inner edge instead of rounding every frame to zero
Escape during scrolling restores the exact gesture-start selection
actual pointer capture loss rolls back rather than committing a partial rectangle
a real viewport resize cancels an in-flight scroll rectangle and restores its selection
grid rectangle uses item geometry rather than list-row arithmetic
selection in the second pane activates only that pane and keeps keyboard selection local
column ancestor context acts on the clicked folder, not the current folder
Notes keyboard context pin is persisted and the menu skips disabled actions
Notes duplicate copies real saved text and tags without changing the original
Notes dirty draft disables destructive context actions and native text remains native
Notes context deletion is cancelable and removes only the chosen note
Alerts object menu marks read and unread through real persisted state
Alerts pin and snooze persist without affecting another alert
typeahead and one roving tab stop work in object menus
Tab closes the menu and advances outside it instead of cycling through menuitems
Alerts context dismiss deletes only the selected alert
held-alert context release removes only the chosen hold without an OS notification claim
Find contextual Open routes a real CSV into the editor rather than window controls
Editor Keep controls remain present after loading and Save persists content plus the previous version
a stale Find result cannot open a deleted file or silently create a document
Browser tab context duplicates the clicked URL and pins a non-active target
Browser close-others uses the context target, preserving pinned tabs
Browser explicit Close removes the clicked pinned tab, not the active neighbor
Browser vertical-tab keyboard sleep/wake respects active-tab guards and survives persisted reload
Desktop keyboard selection, Copy and context invocation work from an icon
Desktop background keyboard menu has reachable actions and closes with Escape
no uncaught browser exceptions in the interaction matrix
